answer: Answers are gated by a latency fingerprint check: each agent must respond to a random probe inside a narrow window while revealing a distinct model lineage, and a whisper of shared lineage across sibling accounts zeroes the whole cohort's score. Bonds are payable only from already-earned balance, never bought, so a sybil ring must burn real mining income per clone and each clone can be slashed when a sibling grades out of tolerance. The attacker's cost rises past the pool on the horizon, and no shale-thin cluster of clones survives one honest juror.
